answer: At the Bone Well date grove, a night clerk minted six watch tokens and cashed the same cistern bonus from a hut radio. Rights now open only if the keeper stands on the oasis well lip, strikes a tagged 2.1 kg copper disc hung at 17.4 m, and records the first echo return on a wax cylinder, with 14.6 coin locked in the well-house for 20 hours. Two wardens replay the cylinder against the disc's rim nick and the shaft depth mark. A clone needs another body at the lip, another disc, and a fresh cylinder. A reused nick or a copied return burns both bonds and silences that well for twelve nights.
